request: Coordinate the body, shoulders, arms and legs as one running pose, using the rear-view Goemon reference.
changes: Stride-synchronized body bank carries the hips, torso, shoulders and head.
Rear arm opens behind the turning chest; elbow and wrist directions inherit the chest frame.
Recovering knees and soles follow the hip frame; planted feet retain world-space anchors and recovery clearance stays above the ground.
Old independent costume shoulder/hip offsets blend into the shared body pose.
Parent-local hierarchical blending preserves limb lengths at low speeds and during diagonal runs.
review: Independent reviewer found no remaining important issues after the partial-weight arm-length correction.

known_existing_issue.description: Broad locomotion suite flags midair leg-length drift during Run to sprint after leaving the ground. Fixed-60-fps baseline and updated build have identical maximum leg-length error, 0.03410542011261 m. Not introduced by this correction.

cleanup_diagnostic: The first packaged Edo alignment run passed all59 assertions but emitted an intermittent ObjectDB/two-resource shutdown diagnostic. A subsequent isolated verbose run passed59/59 and exited without warnings or errors; both logs retained.
